vars.SUB: Relocating. On a timeline. Still looking in November — the June crowd never was.

vars.TITLE: Case notes: the stalled sale
vars.LINES:
The decision to sell was made.
Then one signature stopped coming.
[[gap]]
Showings: blocked.
Calls: unreturned.
Good faith, feeling punished for it.
[[gap]]
So — what happens [[circle]]now?[[/circle]]
vars.NOTE: -> everything in writing. both sides, same information.

vars.HEADLINE: September Shows You Nothing About February
vars.DECK: Roof and ice damming, attic ventilation, the heat and its backup, pipe runs — and who plows the road, under what agreement, at what cost.

vars.TITLE: The estate inventory
vars.LINES:
The paperwork has a checklist.
The garage doesn't.
[[gap]]
Forty years of things.
No obvious order.
Nobody wants to be the one
who throws out what mattered.
[[gap]]
Start with: [[circle]]documents.[[/circle]]
vars.NOTE: -> then keep / distribute / sell / donate. in that order.

vars.KICKER: The Glacier Side of the Valley
vars.HEADLINE:
Columbia Falls
[[i]]and the Canyon[[/i]]
vars.SUB: The closest paved approach to Glacier's west entrance — and the part of the valley everyone drives through without asking what it's like to live there.

vars.HEADLINE: Find It Before The Buyer's Inspector Does
vars.DECK: On your timeline, with three bids — or under contract, with the leverage on the other side of the table. Same roof. Two very different conversations.

vars.TAG: West and Company · How We Work
vars.HEADLINE: Slow Is Smooth. Smooth Is Fast.
vars.DECK: The deadline calendar built the day the contract signs. The lender called before the appraisal is ordered. Nothing done twice — doing it twice is what costs the time.
